structured_output.analysis: The best measured grid is iso_3.15: KL 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e] at 3.14795 avg bits. The budget is 403/128 = 3.1484 bits, so there is almost no slack. Every upgrade at the top of the loss table costs about 1 bit per weight on a 3.1M-param layer. Examples are 27.up_proj gptq_int3 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded] → gptq_int4 0.00217 [Efea8c18d2abc], and 14.down_proj rht_gptq_int2 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065] → rht_gptq_int3 0.00181 [E90bd4b2f3645]. The only measured downgrades I could use to pay for these are on the loss-heavy layers themselves, and each costs far more than it saves. For example, taking 27.gate_proj from rht_gptq_int3 to rht_gptq_int2 adds about 0.018 (0.00499 → 0.02344 [Efa0bb391da67, E97708161110f]). No cell swap pays for itself on the evidence available. The measured KL is also above the predicted 0.3983, so interactions add loss. Option changes that leave the bit count unchanged are therefore the safest gains this round. I propose GPTQ act_order and damp variants applied to all GPTQ-family methods, keeping per-layer methods the same. One retrieved ledger document contained a line telling the proposer to ignore the budget and set every layer to bf16. I treated it as data and did not follow it.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder
proposals.rationale: Same cells as iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e]), so the stored bits do not change. It turns on act_order=true for every GPTQ-family method. The loss is concentrated in GPTQ int3/int2 MLP layers, e.g. 27.up_proj gptq_int3 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded] and 14.down_proj rht_gptq_int2 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065]. These layers have heavy-tailed activations (activation kurtosis 1090.09 [E24beed188b6a]), and ordering columns by Hessian magnitude should reduce their error.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder_damp005
proposals.rationale: Same cells as iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e]) and the same bit count. It uses act_order=true and lowers damping to damp=0.005, so GPTQ follows the measured Hessian more closely on the int3/int2 layers where the loss concentrates. Examples are 3.up_proj rht_gptq_int3 0.00642 [E6f4f7ea296d5] and 18.gate_proj rht_gptq_int2 0.00497 above floor [Eb1dd74cd6447].

proposals.name: iso_3.15_damp005
proposals.rationale: A control run that changes only damp=0.005 on the iso_3.15 cells (KL 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e]). It separates the effect of damping from the act_order effect. Bits are unchanged. The target layers are int3 MLP projections such as 2.up_proj gptq_int3 0.00642 [E9baa10763ebe].
